merchant_memberships_live_outlet_unique.name: merchant_memberships_live_outlet_unique
merchant_memberships_live_outlet_unique.where: "merchant_memberships"."outlet_id" is not null and "merchant_memberships"."revoked_at" is null

payment_attempts_capture_key_check.name: payment_attempts_capture_key_check
payment_attempts_capture_key_check.value: "payment_attempts"."state" not in ('capture_dispatched', 'capture_confirmed', 'capture_unknown') or "payment_attempts"."capture_request_id" is not null

purchase_requests_redemption_check.name: purchase_requests_redemption_check
purchase_requests_redemption_check.value: ("purchase_requests"."redeemed_at" is null and "purchase_requests"."redeemed_by_user_id" is null and "purchase_requests"."purchase_id" is null) or ("purchase_requests"."redeemed_at" is not null and "purchase_requests"."redeemed_by_user_id" is not null and "purchase_requests"."purchase_id" is not null)

purchases_binding_check.name: purchases_binding_check
purchases_binding_check.value: "purchases"."entry_point" = 'fixture_tracer' or ("purchases"."rail" is not null and "purchases"."destination_id" is not null and "purchases"."destination_version" is not null and "purchases"."checkout_key" is not null)
